operation.description: Determines how the 'inclusions' argument is used to modify the SoundBank's inclusion list; 'inclusions' may be used to add to / remove from / replace the SoundBank's inclusion list.

soundbank.description: The ID (GUID), name, or path of the SoundBank to add an inclusion to.

object.description: The ID (GUID), name, or path of the object to add to / remove from the SoundBank's inclusion list.

filter.description: An array of inclusion types defining what to include.

items.description: One of the possible inclusion types.

examples.description: Adds an object to the SoundBank's inclusion list.  The 'media' filter is left out.
examples.title: Adding an object to the inclusion list

examples.description: The SoundBank's inclusion list is cleared via the 'replace' operation and an empty 'inclusions' list.
examples.title: Clearing the inclusion list
